source: Saunders Q&A Review for the NCLEX-RN Examination, 7th ed.

questions.subject: NP III
questions.stem: A client with a new irregular heart rate makes several comments. Which shows READINESS to learn?
questions.rationale: Readiness needs physical and emotional ability; directly asking about the disorder shows interest and motivation. Weakness shows physical inability to learn.
questions.source: Saunders Q&A Review for the NCLEX-RN, 7th ed., Q1308 (PDF p. 1610)
questions.quote: Learning depends on two things: physical and emotional readiness to learn.
